scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @programme/contracts && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w @programme/contracts && npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @programme/contracts && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
